text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to say something very obvious, 
but would you mind listening?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Hard work really does pay off, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even though it should be a given. ...No. 
That is precisely why it makes me so 
happy.
choice_data_list:
We're definitely winning the next race, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
choice_data_list: 今日はパーッとお祝いをしよう！
次のレースも絶対勝とうね！
choice_data_list_en: Let's definitely win the next race too!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, not at all. Celebrating a victory 
is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let's both make sure not to get too 
carried away, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Of course. After all, I must keep on 
winning.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In order to keep winning, one must 
continue to put in the effort.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Please stay by my side and continue to 
guide and support me.
